It is firmly noticeable that having a lack of a partner to practice speaking and having a lack of 
an excellent study environment were the main problems which students encountered when they 
studied at home, followed by 11 (36.66%) and 11 (36.66%). Besides that, the figure for having 
a lack of time for practicing speaking at home was just approximately 27%. This represented 
having a lack of partners & excellent study environment were key factors affecting the ability 
of oral fluency in English speaking of AV113 students.
